notes.title: Version 1.10
notes.content:
Hello knights of fortune and adventurers of Aventuria!

We bring glad tidings from occupied Lowangen! After orcs had pushed back our scouts in skirmishes again and again, the first caravans with new relief goods have finally arrived.  The Svellt Valley has been rebuilt and repaired many times over, and you, dear adventurers, may now feast on what the peoples of Aventuria have given you.

Many thanks to community supporter Martin Wunderlich, he has tirelessly built improvements in mod form and made this patch possible with his unparalleled perseverance. Also many thanks to CaptainKidd (lunatic) for the feature video and many more!

Well, let these things be proclaimed:

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] All mentions of spells are now italicized (thanks, Praiodan!)
[*] The keyword dialog with the swamp witch has been expanded
[*] There are corrected and new texts for the keyword "Weapons"
[*] In Arsingen it is now possible to have clothes dyed
[*] In Lowangen items can now be uncursed (Thanks, Archoran!)
[*] In Nordhag there is a new merchant
[*] In Tjolmar there is now also the possibility to read about the progress of the Orc War
[*] Lowangen now has a cartographer
[*] Tjolmar now has a market hall
[*] Binge: The ignited daywork now makes the binge properly bright
[*] Binge: Climbing the pit ramp has been improved (Thanks, Archoran!) 
[*] Binge: The rest of the group can now follow the leader's slide directly 
[*] Binge: Things can now be stored in some chests
[*] Binge: Dirty dwarves no longer wash themselves in the binge 
[*] Binge: Drinking from the small waterfall in the binge is now possible
[*] Blood Pinnacles: The small golden key, the lynx key and the copper key have been given a function 
[*] Blood Pinnacles: There is now another route to leave the battlements unnoticed also solo play/pacifism suitable
[*] Blood Pinnacles: Improvised throwing projectiles can now be found in a cell 
[*] Blood Pinnacles: Orc patrols carry around random healing herbs and torches 
[*] There is now a good selection of new random events in the swamp
[*] In the swamp there is now a small and a large viewpoint
[*] In the swamp the map is revealed a bit better
[*] There are now slightly fewer archers in the Blood Pinnacles
[*] In the Blood Pinnacles the alarm is now actually triggered 
[*] In the Binge the heroes can now succumb to their greed for gold
[*] Throwing weapons found in chests now appear more in the pack (new game necessary) 
[*] Channels in the cellar vault can be left somewhat more easily
[*] Cellar vaults: Warning is given against entering the labyrinth voluntarily 
[*] Solo: Blood Pinnacles have become more solo friendly
[*] Swamp: the two shelters in the northeast now store repair supplies 
[*] Swamp: the southeastern exit has been reworked 
[*] TDN: there is now a query before leaving the vault 
[*] Blood Pinnacles: The alarm event has been revised 
[*] Blood Pinnacles: The great hall event has been revised 
[*] Blood Pinnacles: The Tairach Priest event has been revised 
[*] The tinker now has a field forge with him
[*] It is now a little easier to find the special water hose
[*] New event in cities: Find herbs
[*] Course of the Orc War: The text about the Battle of the Silk Meadows now also tells who won the battle
[*] Time now passes during the last trip to Kvirasim
[*] Barefoot running now has more noticeable effects
[*] In simplified level advancement (and in the weapon comparison tooltip), comma 5 values are now rounded up. This means more LE and AE per level up
[*] Comfort: If the path is known, Lowangen can also be left via the travel map 
[*] The swamp eulogy now has a lasting effect
[*] Repeated donations at the Rainbow Bridge have been simplified.
[*] The Crystallomancer now gives subtle hints about HOW unbalanced he thinks the trade is
[*] The Crystallomancer now also sells fishing accessories 
[*] The classification of route types (forest, mountain, etc) has been revised
[*] The heroes can be robbed again at night
[*] Weapon maintenance has been significantly simplified
[*] There are now different Claustrophobia thresholds (depending on the oppressiveness of the dungeon section)
[*] Heroes can now carry a bit more weight while remaining more agile
[*] Acrophobia can now have a noticeable effect on hiking in the mountains
[*] Hotkeys! (Combat)
- C like Center or also Camera = Center on character
- A like auto = auto fight
- W as in wait = Wait until end of round
- R like repeat = Repeat action
- Space is already "Skip character"
[*] In all dungeons open (not entered) doors can be closed again 
[*] Battles now yield a bit more adventure points for high level heroes
[*] Orcs now use orcish weapons significantly 
[*] Blacksmiths have become cheaper
[*] Snowshoes now save stamina in winter and mountains 
[*] Solo: The game has become much more suitable for solo runs
[*] Special traders now take back their goods if you accidentally pocket their entire inventory
[*] An autosave is now created before the swamp witch fight
[*] Winter clothing in summer now has more noticeable effects
[*] 2D images fullscreen on special occasions!
[*] 2D images instead of Inside Scenes for Gashok, Golem and Hensger
[*] Replacement of five GUI icons for more intuitive controls (thanks, Torxes!)
[*] A fullscreen image is now shown when entering the big cities for the first time
[*] The monster portrait bear has been improved
[*] The monster portrait of the Spider Queen was adjusted
[*] The quest to track the battle mages has been illustrated (thanks, Drawer!)
[*] The dialog with Arkandor has been illustrated (thanks, Torxes!)
[*] The dialog with the battle mages has been illustrated (thanks, Torxes!)
[*] The dialog with the swamp wreath has been illustrated (thanks, Torxes!)
[*] The shepherd got a fullscreen image (thanks, Drawer!)
[*] The ferries at Tiefhusen and Hilvalla got an inside screen 
[*] The portraits of ogres, orcs and saber-toothed tigers got a tooth-bleeching
[*] The forest goblin attack got a dialog screen 
[*] There are 25 completely new hero portraits
[*] Class descriptions now show atmospheric full screen images
[*] Market stalls now have a dialog picture
[*] Arax poison can now be brewed by yourself
[*] Bastard swords are now wielded with the Swords talent 
[*] The banishing sword has been improved
[*] The mirror amulet now has a practical use
[*] The lion saber is now unbreakable
[*] The magic silver ring has been given a (permanent) spell
[*] The Asthenil weapons have been reworked and now have a very special property
[*] The golden throwing axe now has special properties 
[*] The crystal ball now gives a danger sense bonus when worn (instead of only when equipped)
[*] The robes have been completely reworked 
[*] You can now consume more than one Oneberry at a time
[*] Threadshine has been given a pictogram and now also works on the small ones 
[*] Ranged weapons now also have ini modifiers
[*] Poison application on daggers, special (=non-stackable) throwing weapons and spears now also gives 3 poison applications 
[*] A masterly warhammer is now hidden in the binge (new game required) 
[*] Burning torches and lanterns can now be used to ignite more items 
[*] New whips can now be used to knock enemies off their feet 
[*] New item: Holey Cloth Armor
[*] New item: Rusty Orc Helmet
[*] New item: Dented Plate Armor
[*] New item: Spoiled food
[*] Oil has become much more affordable
[*] Pike and Dragonslayer now hinder the enemy attack by 4
[*] Volcano glass daggers and magic wands yield more profit 
[*] We wish you a lot of fun with Ilmenblattrauchen
[*] Throwing axe stacks have been slightly increased in size 
[*] Defensive combat style now also increases dodge
[*] The fight against Arkandor has been reworked
[*] The sling fight has been improved a bit 
[*] The battle arenas in the swamp have been reworked
[*] The fights against battle mages and elven veterans can now give more experience points for medium level heroes 
[*] The swamp witch got her own battle arena
[*] Swamp Witch creatures now drop more AP
[*] Killed bears now give a big portion of meat
[*] Killed frogs are now actually edible
[*] Magically gifted enemies cast a bit more spells
[*] Swamp: Orcs and undead can fight against each other 
[*] Swamp rats now flee when enough animals of the pack have died 
[*] Modability: "Dwarf Boots 1", "Robe Shoes", "Maiden Shoe", "Dwarf Boots 2", "Barmaid2 Boots" and "Bandit Bootfur" available
[*] Modability: getEquipped also returns prefdisp
[*] Modability: getEquipped now also returns the base break factor and if the weapon itself can be repaired
[*] Modding: There are now the new modifiers "evade" and "oppEvade" to change the evade value of current character or possible target
[*] A soundcheck menu is now accessible from the console - via startdlg("soundcheck") 
[*] Korima is now much better (new game required)
[*] Korima now sells a better two-handed sword 
[*] Battle mages can now be tracked
[*] The quest in the swamp has been completely reworked 
[*] The swamp witch is now able to help the heroes in many ways
[*] Dragen now has a hint where Vindaria lives 
[*] There are now adventure points given when completing the quest "The Golden Eye"
[*] An outro has been created with 2D images
[*] In the Cellar vault you now get the hint to check the entrance again after 100 triggers 
[*] Keyword Ingramosh is now removed only at the end of the quest and not already at the entrance of the Cellar vault
[*] TDN: The encounters with the nameless mage are now more comprehensible 
[*] As already reported by Hagebar, son of Haralda, there is a new event at Finsterkopp
[*] The Blood Pinnacles can now also be entered at the south entrance
[*] During a trip, the current route type is now shown in the console
[*] In case of failed shoplifting, the amount of hush money is displayed in the dialog
[*] The talent "Warfare " can now influence the initiative in a fight
[*] The Solidirid can now be used in a meaningful way (thanks, Archoran!)
[*] The spell "Waterbreath " is now usable
[*] The check for alchemy application have been simplified a bit
[*] In alchemy recipes now also the production difficulty is indicated
[*] Items can now also be ignited by Ignifaxius
[*] Body control can now improve the dodge value in combat 
[*] Axxeleratus can now also be used to dodge better
[*] The check for bargaining at the merchant is a bit easier
[/list]

[b]Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Even if you have already talked to other special people in Lowangen, Dragan will now talk to you
[*] Gashok's citizens can no longer be infinitely enchanted in dialogues
[*] Hiltorp: Budrim, son of Ebbo, no longer rants about his own people 
[*] In the swamp near the heather, the hero no longer addresses himself when carrying the document
[*] In the Blood Pinnacles, the levels are now numbered correctly
[*] Numerous typos and spelling errors have been corrected
[*] It is now easier to drink from the well in Sibra
[*] Erholt of Tiefhusen is now called Erhold of Tiefhusen
[*] Finsterkoppen and Lowangen: Overnight regeneration pays better attention to hero equipment
[*] Finsterkoppen: You can no longer trade yourself rich at the Finsterkoppen dwarven shopkeeper. However, their special offer itself remains
[*] Finsterkoppen: If you decide not to spend the night in Finsterkoppen, you can now leave the dwarven house
[*] In Gashok, alcohol is no longer served
[*] Kvirasim: Clicking on the herbalist will now also open the correct merchant inventory
[*] Before entering Lowangen, it is once again suggested to prepare for the stay 
[*] Binge: The main entrance of the binge is now a bit easier to leave 
[*] Binge: The lockpick-eating chest in the Finsterkoppen Binge is now not quite as hungry (for real this time)
[*] Binge: The copper key door can no longer be opened with the double bit key 
[*] Binge: Solo heroes can now skip the pit in the binge
[*] Binge: Dead heroes no longer scorch at the golem
[*] Blood Pinnacles: You can now no longer rise from the dead on the Spider Queen
[*] Blood Pinnacles: The battle mage in the cell now only gives AP once
[*] Blood Pinnacles: The golden spectacled key key is now correctly removed after use 
[*] Blood Pinnacles: The lava lake in the Blood Pinnacles is no longer a bottomless pit
[*] Blood Pinnacles: The Tairach chest can now be clicked on more easily
[*] Blood Pinnacles: A storage shelf in the Blood Pinnacles now asks a specific question
[*] Blood Pinnacles: Emptied piles of straw are now recognized as such 
[*] Blood Pinnacles: It is now slightly less likely to encounter spiders 
[*] Blood Pinnacles: Fixed bug "First dormitory orkfree - all dorms orkfree"
[*] Blood Pinnacles: Not all doors are locked anymore
[*] Blood Pinnacles: Claustrophobia is reset after leaving the Blood Pinnacles (the real level 2) 
[*] Blood Pinnacles: They are now easier to exit at the main entrance
[*] Blood Pinnacles: Solo heroes now also get Ap for finding secret doors
[*] Blood Pinnacles: Triggers are no longer triggered twice 
[*] Cellar vault: The climbing route has been simplified and the reward increased 
[*] Cellar vault: The Street-smart check now work correctly
[*] Cellar vault: The last door is no longer locked
[*] Cellar vault: It is now possible to pass the last level
[*] Cellar vaults: Bugfix when exiting in solo play
[*] Cellar vault: Spoilers removed from the console when awarding APs
[*] Swamp: It is now also possible to search for ammunition in the swamp
[*] TDN: Amulet parts can no longer be collected after opening the door
[*] TDN: The gong fights do not repeat infinitely anymore 
[*] TDN: fixed possible bugs when leaving the temple 
[*] TDN: NPCs that are not in the active group no longer try to escape in the 3rd level
[*] Skinning the basilisk is now safely possible 
[*] The ferryman in Svellmia is now responsive again 
[*] The otter can now be skinned professionally
[*] The deer hunter now prefers to use his favorite hunting weapon
[*]Basilisk pestilence has been toned down a bit: The *max* life energy cannot drop below 10; dying is still possible, however
[*] The prices in the brothel are now calculated correctly
[*] Dwarven crossbow and trident can now also be used to hunt deer
[*] Orc camp: Special items remain available to the heroes
[*] Agdan and the Vinsalter now take better care of their personal possessions
[*] The number of talent increase attempts per talent increase (simplified increase) has been revised
[*] Merchants no longer enrage upon successful haggling
[*] You can now be raided during a rest in all dungeons
[*] Tutelary God Travia: Healing Poison exchanged for Healing Disease
[*] The icon of the Golden spectacled key has been improved
[*] New dialog image for the encounter with the she-bear
[*] Red colored orc hair is now less glowing 
[*] Tiefhusen raises colored flags again
[*] (Masterly) spears are now correctly wielded two-handed 
[*] Witches now also need time for their rituals (24 h)
[*] Banedust, Lotus Poison and Masterwork Tuzak Knifes have become more affordable 
[*] The weight of slingshot ammunition has been corrected 
[*] The ritual for the witch's 4. Ball Enhancement spell works again 
[*] The trident can now be wielded one-handed
[*] The Gruuf Shark, Lion Sabre and numerous other weapons have been corrected 
[*] The name of orcish clothing is displayed correctly again
[*] The Ring Armor now is now sold at a much more reasonable price
[*] The Thrusting Spear can now also be used by dwarves 
[*] The name of the Chain Coifs no longer reminds of iron helmets
[*] The dragon claw now is still properly labled after quest completion 
[*] The secret anti-potions now work
[*] The pike can no longer be used by witches, mages and druids
[*] The TP/KK of Oxherd and Byakka have been corrected 
[*] Dwarven armor can now be kept through orc army camps 
[*] Captured volcanic glass daggers are now usable by everyone 
[*] Weight and value of the goblin gifts has been corrected
[*] Imported soul instruments can now be assigned to an owner once
[*] Bellchime Flower Bouquet and master flute are now sellable at a reasonable price 
[*] Name and description of the green robe in German corrected
[*] Orcish bronze bottles can now be drunk without knowing the contents 
[*] Rare bugs in the ignite function have been fixed 
[*] Blunt slashing weapons can no longer be poisoned and sharpened 
[*] Uuz'Dornak is now sold at a reasonable price 
[*] Selling prices of weapons at weapon market stalls increased significantly (almost like in the store); analogous to herbal items 
[*] Throwing poisons and tinctures are now sold at their best price at the herbalist again 
[*] Agdan is now less suicidal in combat after his release 
[*] Opponents can now also be afraid of undead and demons
[*] Combat with Arkandor has been made more interesting
[*] Combat damage for damage resistances and the Gardinium spell is now calculated correctly.
[*] The "knocked down" message has been expanded 
[*] Fire Ghosts now cause fire damage according to their nature 
[*] Immunity to fire works again
[*] Fighters can suffer slips again
[*] Critical hits from predatory cats are now better displayed in the console 
[*] Skeletons are no longer resistant to cutting damage
[*] Solo: In the combat tutorial solo heroes no longer have to attack the trainer in the group
[*] When enemies dodge, "oppEvade" is now correctly taken into account instead of "oppPA"
[*] Temple flags can now be replaced again via mod
[*] Spells with ZfW less than -90 are no longer displayed in the character sheet even in "full view".
[*] Yosmina can now accompany the group as an NPC
[*] Keyword Aboralm is now removed after the quest ends
[*] Upon entering Kvirasim, you are not immediately thrown back to the travel map
[*] The trail to Finsterkoppenbinge has been revamped
[*] Swamp: Positioning on travel map after leaving the swamp corrected
[*] When selecting an item, it is now possible to choose from the entire hero inventory again. More items are also shown per page
[*] The hero weight in the in-game hero generator is calculated correctly again
[*] The resume game button resumes the game again
[*] The calculation of the body weight in hero generation is correct again.
[*] The English language setting is now preserved
[*] The output_log is written again
[*] Various spells now keep their effect after reloading (new savegame necessary)
[*] Redundant resolution settings have been removed
[*] The lynch mob in Gahsok is now musically supported
[*] The correct music for the situation is now properly played
[*] In combat, only combat music plays
[*] Music is now played in the warehouse
[*] Female Idle spells are no longer always the same
[*] Alchemy no longer requires multiple bottles
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.04, Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Aventurians!

After a long break, we have a patch for you again, fitting for the delay this is also a bit more extensive. In addition to a whole lot of smaller bug fixes, some bigger things were tackled as well. Among other things, there is now a "Comparison Tooltip" that allows you to compare your current equipment with an item in inventory or at a shop. We also added 32 new character portraits and as a big bugfix we significantly increased the performance in Lowangen. In detail:

[list]
[*] Weapons and armor are now compared in detail in both the character sheet and the shops with worn equipment
[*] Error when importing Blade of Destiny saves fixed; Characters with bolts in the left hand were skipped
[*] Doubleclick in the inventory equips an item, if that is possible
[*] Levelups were possible during the fight, aren't any more
[*] Many translation bugs and inconsistencies fixed, especially in the Ingame Help
[*] Several talent translations were adapted
[*] The "Mage's cauldron" is now correctly called "witches cauldron"
[*] Several Steamachievements have been fixed and now work correctly
[*] Markers now appear on the Travel Map when dungeons are discovered
[*] All weapons received an Initiative Modifier
[*] The weapons tooltip now displays the weapon's Initiative Modifier, Damage, and required Ammo type
[*] A total of 32 new class portraits have been added
[*] Levelups can now be aborted and the talent and spell gains / attempts used on the next Levelup
[*] The display of combat values ​​in the character screen has been supplemented by a line for "modification by weapon"
[*] Display the unmodified chance of success for spells in the character sheet
[*] Robes and cloaks have received new models
[*] Item loss corrected when distributing stacks
[*] The load game menu looks a little better now
[*] "Disappearing hair" has been corrected when using certain capes
[*] Certain weapons can no longer be used by dwarfs because they are too big - the weapons that is
[*] The display at the cauldron ritual check has been improved
[*] Digital Deluxe: The application of the weed ointment was provided with feedback
[*] Ice Elfs are now immune to frost damage
[*] The travel encounter with the druid has been improved
[*] A corpse finding while traveling is now a unique event
[*] Some texts have been corrected
[*] The Halmar Antelope event is unique now
[*] Magic characters (except Mages) now need Thonnys to meditate
[/list]

[h1]Dungeons & Towns[/h1]
[list]
[*] The performance in Lowangen was increased noticeably
[*] In the Hesinde Temple of Lowangen, a schematic outline map about Lowangen is now available

[*] Conversations in taverns do not break off early anymore

[*] Marketplaces no longer change the assortment with each call
[*] The dungeon tutorial now triggers correctly no matter which dungeon you visit first

[*] The big copper key in Finsterkoppen Pit works again
[*] Some display errors in Lowangen have been fixed
[*] Dwarfs are under no circumstances to lure into the binge bath anymore. Wimps neither.
[*] In the Finterkoppenbinge, the heroes can now succumb to their greed for gold
[*] The cart trigger in the swamp has been improved
[*] In Gashok elves are now the "preferred target"
[*] Chests can no longer be opened through walls or doors
[*] Moved village boundaries in Hilvalla, Norhus and Svellmia to prevent underwater running
[*] Entrance of Tiefhusen from travelling is now on the "right" side
[*] The Stand-Still-voiceover comes now only every 3 minutes
[*] The bane sword can now also be sanctified on the night of the 1st of Hesinde
[*] In the Blood Pinnacles, the burning hay stops burning at some point
[*] An error in the Blood Pinnacles with the guards has been corrected
[*] Some infinity XP exploits have been removed
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Model for Swamp Rantzels
[*] New, prettier model for Harpies
[*] Fixed an infinite loop in the combat tutorial
[*] The combat inability is now removed when healing in combat
[*] Unsuccessful weapon exchanges don't cost an action any more
[*] Fixed an issue where opponents do not die by spell
[*] Sabretooth tigers are now properly removed from combat when dead
[*] Fixed getting stuck in a certain street arena
[*] The lighting of some battle arenas has been fixed
[*] Opponents now take their nametag when they flee
[*] The lockpick-eating chest in the Finsterkoppen Pit is not that hungry anymore.
[/list]

[h1]Modding[/h1]
[list]
[*] The expiration of items has been corrected
[*] Fixed an error with script inheritance in the keyword dialogues
[/list]

Happy holidays to you all, we are looking forward to a successful year 2018 together!

notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.content:
Hail to the twelve!

We have a juicy package full of updates, improvements and fixes for you dearest adventurers! Most important is the fix of the dreaded Bloodscreen of death in the blood pinnacles, caused by a bug in our Engine Unity 5.6.2 which was only fixable with a major version upgrade to 2017.1. Big fix number 2 is a bug that prevented enemies of falling over in rare cases - this is bug is marked "busted" too. And there is a ton of detail adaptions, see for yourself:

[H1]General[/H1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug importing Blade of Destiny characters. They were skipped when they had bolts in their hand.
[*] Double-clicking items makes shopping easier
[*] Examining weapons and armor at traders highlights characters that can use them
[*] In the trader window, the item description is now displayed in the tooltip
[*] The user interface is now scaleable (under Settings -> Graphic effects)
[*] Cooking duration for all recipes has been completely revised (and shortened)
[*] Introducing new weapon: Dwarven hammer
[*] There is now a matching lower body armor for the deluxe dwarf chestplate
[*] Crystal ball enchantments are now available for witches too (needs a special crystal ball)
[*] Intro and main menu music finally obey volume settings
[*] The characters in the character window were moved up and re more visible now
[*] Herbs have become much more affordable
[*] The prices of magic and healing potions were systematized
[*] The green amulet now lights up when worn
[*] The inventory no longer automatically closes when reading recipes
[*] When the real salamander stone is found, the quest for the wrong salamander stone is automatically ended
[*] A bug in the tutorial and the help has been fixed: Haggling is always done by the best character and not, as claimed so far, by the leader
[*] The ingame character editor has been revised, various problems have been corrected
[*] The description of torch and lantern now states maximum burn time
[*] Fixed an AE exploit with the Kairan potion
[*] Fixed a problem with battlefield fever
[*] The crystallomant now has a better grip on the value of his commodity
[*] Characters can be rotated in the Character screen again
[/list]

[H1]Towns & Dungeons[/H1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Bloodpinnacles "Bloodscreen of Death" (Crash to Desktop without warning)
[*] Finsterkoppen now has special dwarf taverns
[*] Market stall usability has been improved
[*] Market stalls and shops can now be robbed
[*] The floating palisade of New Lowangen has found its place on the earth
[*] On the Hanging Bridge there are now 4 actually visible Orks
[*] Peraida bought a new dress

[*] Enemies now take their name tag display with them when they flee

notes.title: Version 0.95
notes.content:
Hail to the twelve!

This Update was all about "Sound": Actions in the inventory and out of it result in "audible Feedback", footsteps change their tone when stepping on a different underground, torches sizzle audible in Dungeons, water drips in caves and flows on fountains. We also included reworked spells, elfs now have their own "elfish representation" of the according formula. Combat also sounds a lot more lively, even though it isn't completely done yet, there is more to come! In Detail:

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] The heroes now give audible comments in certain situations (e.g., injured, becoming leader)
[*] All doors in dungeons now have soundeffects
[*] Soundeffects added to inventory actions (e.g. eat, equip and drop)
[*] Warriors and Dwarfs now get a bonus on encumberance ("armor familiarity")
[*] Mages, druids, and witches can now access new wardrobes.
[*] The travel experience "buzz and hum" now has a soundeffect.
[*] It is now possible to exchange water in the inventory between waterskins and glass / water bottles.
[*] In dialogs with group NPCs their portraits are now displayed.
[*] The footstep sounds now adapt to the respective underground.
[*] A further fix attempt was made for blurry spell texts
[*] Spell voiceovers have been completely replaced, there are also separate elf interpretations
[*] The spell "Eagle, Wolf" is now only applicable to the caster himself.
[*] The effect "healattempt" after trying to heal wounds now lasts 24 hours instead of formerly 8.
[*] Effect "healattempt" is now no longer set on several other occasions, like with dagger rituals or when sleeping in Finsterkoppen
[*] A rabies infection is no longer identifiable by medical practitioners
[*] The group NPCs now have their correct portraits. Caution: Unfortunately, this does not work with existing savegames, if the respective NPC is already or was in the group.
[*] More than 60 dialogs and events were given images from game assets.
[*] Inadvertently deactivated 8 landroute random events now trigger again.
[*] 6 key icons have received a wooden background.
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] When having Agility 16 or better, a character receives +1 movement per action
[*] Created a special arena for the fight in Ingramosch's house.
[*] Significantly more fighting sounds were implemented, some non-humanoids and few humanoids are still inactive
[*] "Wait until end of turn" now works again
[*] Skeletons are now losing their weapon visually as well es in the code
[*] Prevent yellow battle messages in accelerated combat, only show LE / AE changes.
[*] The life energy of the Dragon Arkandor was significantly increased.
[*] The starting positions of a battle in the Vault beneath Tjolmar have been corrected
[*] Another fight in the Vault beneath Tjolmar has been corrected
[/list]

[h1]Towns and Dungeons[/h1]
[list]
[*] Swamp of the Forgotten: You move very slow in swamp grass.
[*] Reworked ambient sound in Finsterkoppen Pit
[*] Reworked ambient sound in Swamp of the Forgotten
[*] Illusion walls in the blood pinnacles now disappear when they are discovered
[*] Various item containers (chests, shelves, cabinets etc.) in the vault beneath Tjolmar don't show unnecessary warnings any more.
[*] The missing transversalis targets in the vault beneath Tjolmar have been added.
[*] Druids and witches are now allowed to pass the guards at the Finsterkoppen mountain entrance.
[*] The sunken chest in the Swamp of Forgiveness now includes a pair of trousers and a shirt that can be worn later on by Agdan Dragenfeld.
[*] The text for opening and closing the secret door in the Vault beneath Tjolmar is now displayed only once.
[*] The "LOD" system for characters has been disabled, the village characters should now look better
[*] Fixed blood pinnacles on lowest quality
[*] When entering the swamp, you no longer land behind a barrier.
[*] Prevented falling through the ground in the Vault beneath Tjolmar
[*] The handling of Aumond has been fixed, it is now unaccessible as planned
[*] Hillhaus is accessible again
[*] Swamp of the Forgotten: The usefulness of the minimap has been improved.
[*] Some stairs in the Vault beneath Tjolmar were "sealed"
[*] Swamp of the Forgotten: Prevented hanging in the boats.
[*] The Lanterns in the Swamp of Forgiveness now have a correct collisions.
[*] Some "catapults" in the blood pinnacles have been corrected
[*] In case you have the "correct" heather, but not the Noctrux document, an additional query and a new text have been added.
[*] There is now an Autosave before the NPC leaves the group in the 3rd level of the Vault beneath Tjolmar.
[*] In the Vault beneath Tjolmar the assignment of the adventure points was completely revised.
[*] Vault beneath Tjolmar: The heroes are now told about the use of the flame key.
[*] Vault beneath Tjolmar: The heroes are now informed about the loss of amulet parts.
[*] The trigger positions in the Vault beneath Tjolmar have been reworked.
[*] The Hiltorp priest now correctly has a female avatar.
[*] There are now torches and tinders in level 6 of the Finsterkoppen Pit
[*] Blood Pinnacles: You can not get the Gravesh dagger several times now.
[*] Water bottles can now also be filled on the rivers in Tiefhusen and Gashok.
[*] The blacksmith in Gashok now also allows elves, who can not be recognized as elves by the spells "eagle, wolf", "harmless figure" or "visibili".
[*] Blood Pinnacles: Fight in large hall triggers no more a second time
[*] Blood Pinnacles: Fleeing Ork can now sound an alarm
[/list]

[h1]Modding[/h1]
[list]
[*] Voiceover Modding is now possible
[*] Directories can now be given as source not only for image files, but also for general files
[*] Character classes can now have permanent effects (like check boni)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.85
notes.content:
Hail to the twelve!

Sorry for the delay of this versions release. Biggest addition and therefore worth a bigger Version leap is the accessability of the Dungeon below Tjolmar including the fight againast Arkandor and therefore the completeability of the game! So all dungeons and towns from the original can now be entered. In Detail:

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] More than 600 additional translations implemented, tutorial is still to come
[*] The zoom factor of the minimap and the full-screen map is now saved
[*] You can now set, edit and delete your own markers on the minimap
[*] The setting for the spell display can now be easily made in the settings window and no longer need to be done via XML / Mod
[*] Tooltips will no longer get stuck
[*] After completing a Levelup, music will switch back to the usual ambient for the location
[*] The lion sabre can now be repaired
[/list]

[h1]Dungeons & Towns[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Dungeon under Tjolmar is now accessible and the game can be finished
[*] Leave the minimap visible without a light source, "only" deactivate removal of Fog of War
[*] Fixed an error when the current group becomes empty (eg loss of the last member into a deep hole)
[*] Items do not "hang" out of their grids in the warehouse anymore
[*] Resting won't place the group somewhere else any more
[*] More floating objects in Lowangen are now on the ground again
[*] Fixed the doors in the blood pinnacles dungeon
[*] Fixed an event where grasping into a hole won't continue with a response
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] The two golden shields are actually golden in battle
[*] Humanoid NPCs now need to roll bravery checks in the presence of demons and / or undead
[*] Surrouned ranged fighters now correctly change to a melee weapon or unarmed combat
[*] The bow animation is now selected correctly
[*] Monsters are now using correctly calculated encumberance, initiative, and dodge values
[*] Arkandor is able to spit Ignifaxius
[*] movement points can not drop below 1
[*] Fixed a fight in the blood pinnacles to always have room for all enemies
[*] Movement points and Ini are now updated immediately, not with the start of the next combat round
[*] Fixed an animation hang of the wood gnome
[*] Shields are now considered correctly
[*] Fixed display of dodge and parry chances
[*] Fixed combatgrid brightness
[*] Broken monster weapons no longer cause a hang
[/list]

[h1]Modding[/h1]
[list]
[*] Battles can now be scripted, eg to integrate dialogues in combat
[*] New function getItemset
[*] The Battlearena Editor can now place and move objects by mouse
[*] Battlestances are now changeable by script
[*] The modding character editor is now fully translated
[*] Fixed some bugs in modding character editor
[/list]

The next steps will be finalizing locations known as "Dialog Towns" as well as adding (a lot of!) sounds and optimizations, especially for Kvirasim and Lowangen.

Hail to the twelve!

We have a large "stabilization update" for you this week, almost 90 changes should make your life in Aventuria more pleasant, especially in combat, where now among other things shields are represented and correctly taken into account and the NPCs now also switch weapons, or put the weapon away when they are encircled to continue fighting. In detail:

[h1]General[/h1][list]
[*] Some diseases now require a whole set of herbs for healing

[*] The main menu difficulty window size has been increased
[*] Unconscious and rehealed heroes will be displayed correctly again at the next camp
[*] Hungry and thirsty heroes no longer help themselves to alchemy ingredients
[*] Fixed a problem with item containers and items that were moved to characters other than the currently active character
[/list]
[h1]Cities and Dungeons[/h1][list]
[*] The party is shown in the dungeon-campscreen
[*] NPCs were persuaded to remain invisible when they are supposed to be
[*] Running in doors in the blood pinnacles now looks better

[*] Market stalls have been repaired
[*] Fixed the runin animation in other existing dungeons
[*] NPCs no longer slowly turn on the spot

[*] Prevented NPCs in Tjolmar passing through the walls and palisades
[*] The torches in the first 3 levels of the Finsterkoppenbinge dungeon, which are inflamed by Ingerimms day work, now go out again after 12 hours
[*] Trigger a chance to counter the fire sponge effect in the Finsterkoppenbinge every hour
[*] Fixed the coordinates of the rear entrance of the blood pinnacles dungeon
[*] Fixed some holes in the walls of the blood pinnacles dungeon
[*] Thurazz only joins the party once
[*] The Tairach priests rom no longer triggers multiple times
[*] Empty chests in the blood pinnacles now trigger a corresponding hint
[/list]
[h1]Travel[/h1] [list]
[*] When resting on journeys, the console shows which modifiers the camp has
[*] Fixed a save/load problem on the travel map after displaying scenes
[*] Fixed a problem with the basilisk event
[*] Limited the maximum regeneration bonus in nature camps
[*] Fixed another problem with basilisk event
[/list]
[h1]Combat[/h1][list]
[*] Crowbar, Pickaxe and Shovel can now be used as improvised weapons
[*] There is now a spiderqueen battle avatar
[*] All monster portals have been reworked
[*] Fixed a problem with the end of combat mode
[*] The initial position of the combat camera is now much more meaningful
[*] Fixed the Gorger and Arkandor getting stuck
[*] The loot window after the battle is no longer in "combat mode", so equipment can also be changed
[*] Ogres were reduced to 2x2 squares and should now have fewer problems when filling battle arenas
[*] Fixed drawing paths for enemies
[*] Fixed enemy alignment in autobattle
[*] Used up throwing weapons and lost weapons are correctly removed from the avatars hand
[*] Alignment and looking direction was fixed for the heroes
[*] The bow animation is chosen correctly when using a bow
[*] Fixed various problems in auto battle with ranged fighters
[*] NPCs are now using their shield correctly, if they have one
[*] Corretly show a weapon switch
[*] Fixed a few lighting problems in battle arenas
[*] Enemies now cast their Ignifaxius with more than 1-6 damage
[*] The action display is now correctly updated when the current weapon is switched
[*] Some probabilities in battle were displayed too high or too low
[*] Removed unnecessary messages when loading a battle
[*] The dodging and not the parry value will now be correctly used for remote attack
[*] Fixed the Ghul avatar getting stuck
[*] Fixed shield bearers getting their dodge made more difficult for no reason
[*] Equipped shields are now displayed in the battlearena
[*] Correctly consider shields in calculating chances
[*] Fixed a problem with the stagga beatle battle
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.81
notes.content:
Hail to the twelve!

With today Update the Blood pinnacles dungeon is finally available, a content extension promising several hours of additional gameplay! Moreover, the trade interface was completely reworked and is immensely more comfortable than before, and of course there were huge amount of bug fixes and feature implementations!

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] There is a trade interface
[*] Limited clothing colors to more realistic values
[*] Remastered soundtrack is completely implemented
[*] New spell "Silentium"
[*] New spell "Abvenenum"
[*] Korima of Attica now demands weekly payment
[*] There is a chance to aquire a Lions Sabre
[*] Several applications of curiosity implemented
[*] When meeting the Baron of Meresfeld, the dialog is now centered
[*] Rebalanced all prices in trading
[*] You now need some tool to craft arrows and bolts
[*] Crytal ball, magic wand and vulcan glass dagger now have a button to show the effects of their respective ritual levels
[*] Improved Elsurion intro sequence
[*] No more losing items when choosing "take all" in the container window
[*] Fixed A save- and loadproblem on the travelmap after scene displays
[*] Fixed display of orc armor
[*] Fixed torches and lanterns not going out
[*] Special travel events only trigger once
[*] Cleaned up ingame loading sequence
[*] Improved Number-Entering Dialog (like for haggling or "how long do you want to rest?")
[*] Improved overlapping of items in the character screen
[*] Made Classic soundtrack available as alternative to remastered
[*] Mark twohanded weapons as such in the tooltip
[*] Item origin stories display an image of the item
[*] Fixed Compass-north-display with static as well as rotating map. Implemented "N" key to toggle between static and rotating
[*] Fixed too dark display of items in the blacksmith dialog
[*] Fixed a problem creating ice elfs
[*] Fixed a problem with the basilisk encounter
[*] The lynx event now drops supplies
[*] Fixed guard functionality when resting
[*] Fixed flying characters in camp screens
[*] Time and weather now display immmediately after loading a camp scene
[*] Fixed several bad hairstyle/headwear combinations
[*] Fixed effects not showing up on portraits right away
[*] Fixed display of formerly unconscious characters in camp screens
[*] Fixed Linux import path
[/list]
[h1]Towns & Dungeons[/h1]
[list]
[*] Unlocked Blood Pinnacles Dungeon
[*] Resting outside in Towns now also displays weather and heroes
[*] Unique icon for "Look for a seat" in Taverns
[*] Reworked Peraine temple
[*] Made Heather bushes visible in the swamp
[*] Removed "Jumping" on the lowangen southern bridge
[*] Fixed water in Gashok
[*] Secured outsides of the swamp
[*] Fixed reuniting of party parts
[*] Fixed a bug with the battle mage chasers
[*] No more nightly attacks inside of hostels
[*] Reduced frequency of "No-Trousers"-Event
[*] Fixed the "Gavron"-part of Dragan Escht's dialog
[*] Fixed receiving the Keys to Lowangen multiple times
[*] Fixed after battle placement at Ailian Siebenquell's
[/list]
[h1]Battle[/h1]
[list]
[*] Allow a Rondra-pleasing one on one battle with Baron Meresfeld
[*] Improved beggars army battle
[*] Fixed a problem loading battles when traveling
[*] Reduced size of the wolf battle avatars
[/list]
[h1]Modding[/h1]
[list]
[*] Allow to play an arbitrary playlist by script
[*] The new trader window is way more adaptable
[*] Implemented a safety in Lowangen to not leave behind NPCs
[*] New scene "lonely desert"
[*] Improved Craftytool, it now can handle Encumberment zero weapons and improvised weapons
[*] Changes to the inventory now show up right away when the character screen is open
[/list]
[b]Should anybody happen to be at Roleplay Convention in Cologne this weekend, pay Christian Weinmuellner a visit, he is the developer and project lead and would be happy to meet and greet![/b]

notes.content:
Hail to the twelve!

We were able to carry through on a big promise of ours: Importing games from Blade of destiny HD. It was implemented and now imports your dear heroes from our predecessor. Other data is imported too, heroes below 1.450 XP will be upgraded to that value. The game doesn't have to be finished, but it must reside in the old savegame directory (Documents/BladeofDestiny/save).

And there are other updates too:

notes.title: Version 0.79
notes.content:
Hail Hesinde my Dears!

Hesinde is the aventurian goddess of wisdom and magic, and magic is exactly what we did together with our Alpha Team right before the Easter Holidays! New Features include unlocking of the Steam Workshop, which allows supereasy installation of Mods. Moreover, the DSA CraftyTool found its way onto your hard drive, required for creating those Mods. I want to bring your attention to http://wiki.sternenschweif.com , it is just german at the moment but it can be a starting point, and we are happy to help anybody wanting to get involved! And I wanted to thank my hard-working Alpha Team that not only tested everything before releasing it to you, but who also provided some of their Mods as starting points for the Workshop!

But the real magic is in the sheer amount of changes in the last 7 days, see for yourself:

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] The camp scene on travels now displays all heros that are able to act
[*] The camp scene on travels now shows the current weather conditions and the time of day
[*] Dullskull was revised. Dwarfs are now especially bad tempered when suffering from it
[*] The dwarf crossbow received a unique image
[*] When surviving a serious illness without any healing, the according hero receives experience
[*] Battle fever was revised. Elfs suffer more than other races
[*] Rabies was revised. Elfs are immune to it, all others now actually get the rabies
[*] A problem when repeatedly changing a characters worn wardrobe was fixed
[*] Fixed a problem that the toadskin caused a false skin shade to be displayed
[*] Fixed a problem that when "taking all" and the inventory was full, a random item went missing
[*] Adapting the looks of heroes in the temple doesn't cause lighting problems any more
[*] The cloud animation in the main menu doesn't disappear any more when using the settings window
[*] The white lines in the main menu are finally fixed
[*] Female goblins can now be created correctly
[*] Canceling the hero choice when casting destructibo now works as intended
[/list]

[h1]Towns and Dungeons[/h1]
[list]
[*] The cellar vault dialogs received some images
[*] A blurry texture at the blacksmith of Tjolmar was fixed
[*] Female NPCs aren't bald any more
[*] The leather clothes chest in the Finsterkoppen Pit now works as intended
[*] Lowangen nighttime lighting was fixed
[*] Fixed a texting problem at the scales puzzle in the Cellar Vault
[*] Filled several dorment houses in Tjolmar with life
[*] Fixed a z-fighting chest cover in Tiefhusen
[*] Fixed a flying basket in Tiefhusen
[*] Fixed a missing well collision in Tiefhusen
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] The witches broom now receives an additional damage point for every 5 battle rounds it is active, making it gradually even more dangerous
[*] Depth of Field in combat now auto-focusses on characters
[*] Added a new battle avatar for trolls
[*] Used the new goblin race for all goblin opponents
[/list]

[h1]Modding[/h1]
[list]
[*] Unlocked Steam Workshop
[*] It is now possible to hand out XP in effects
[*] Added possiblity to add avatars and templates by mod
[*] Readded images in Dialogs
[*] Allowed overwriting of existing files in Modding Character Editor
[*] Fixed several bugs when creating Goblinsin the Modding Character Editor
[/list]

We'll release the next update in roughly 2 Weeks, so around the 28th of April! Happy Easter from the Alpha- and Crafty Teams!

notes.title: Version 0.78 released
notes.content:
Hail to the twelve!

With todays Patch the Character editor so far only available for the "modding" area is now also active in the "normal" game. When generating characters in the temple, there is a new button "Edit Look" right below the left "Roll dice" button. Almost every detail of your new character can be adapated here, Moreover, generated characters from now on display their worn equipment instead of always looking the same!

ATTENTION: Existing Charakters are NOT automatically displaying their equipment! In order to make them, please go to a temple, activate the "Group management" and use the new button "Edit Character Looks" on the respective portrait and possibly adapt your character. After closing the editor, the equipment should also be displayed for existing characters. This is only necessary once!

Aside from the character editor there were many additional Updates:

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] The new background scene "Brinasker marshes" was added eingefügt
[*] Added a background scene for the courtyard in Lowangen
[*] Added a background scene for the talks with Artherion
[*] Added a background scene for the academies of Lowangen
[*] Several Character choices now have additional help for the probability of success as a tooltip
[*] It is now possible to outwear your shoes
[*] A problem resetting the mood of dialogue partners was fixed
[*] Leather armor and winter coat adapted
[*] A problem using tarnels was fixed
[*] Newly created characters aren't naked any more, but wear their respective Equipment
[*] Fixed a hang on the "Svellt Beauty" quest
[*] Improved the keyword dialog of the "Svellt Beauty" Quest
[*] A bug in the healer scene causing a lot of followup trouble was fixed
[/list]
[h1]Battle[/h1]
[list]
[*] Orcs were updated and can now wear all human equipment too
[*] A problem with the movement calculation of multi field opponents was fixed
[*] A problem with choosing targets in Autobattle was fixed
[*] Enemies with natural weapons (eg. Swamp corpses) cannot "break" their weapon anymore
[*] Conjured ghosts do not sink into the ground any more
[*] Lighting problems in several battle arenas were fixed
[/list]
[h1]Dungeons & Towns[/h1]
[list]
[*] The dialog at the Lowangen Magistrate regarding donating weapons was improved
[*] Transversalis-points in the Swamp of the Forgotten were added
[*] A problem sleeping in Finsterkoppen was fixed
[*] The night lighting in Tiefhusen was fixed
[*] The Weapon Dealers of Lowangen exchanged their signs
[*] The keyword dialogs in several temples of Lowangen were fixed
[*] The barrels of Gashok are now obstacles
[*] The market stalls of Gashok are now obstacles
[*] The lanterns of Gashok are now Obstacles
[*] The lanterns of Finsterkoppen are now obstacles
[*] The lanterns of Tjolmar are now visible
[*] The wood pile in the Swamp is now an obstacle
[*] Clipping problems with the city walls of Lowangen were fixed
[*] Flickering at the northern gate of Lowangen was fixed
[*] Several wrongly placed NPCs in Lowangen were fixed
[*] The Orcs of Lowangen won't take away the tops of female characters
[*] Several keyword dialog problems in Tjolmar were fixed
[*] Improved the Tjolmar blacksmith
[*] Only turn once to the donation bowl on the rainbow bridge in Lowangen
[*] Improved notes to Dragans Quests in Lowangen
[*] When swimming in the Swamp everybody looks above the water
[*] Fixed a problem with starting the witch quest in the Swamp
[/list]
[h1]Modding[/h1]
[list]
[*] Male Trolls can now be generated in the Modding Character Editor
[*] Goblins were updated and are now also available in the Modding Character Editor
[*] Female Characters received the new set "Bandit"
[*] Characters can now be deactivated in Inside Scenes
[*] Checks for hero equipment were created more modding-friendly
[/list]

The next patch will be released next weekend since we will attend Reboot Develop in Dubrovnik from April 20th to 22nd!

notes.title: Update Version 0.75
notes.content:
I apologize for the long time since the last update, I was sick for the better part of the last two weeks and unable to release the already completed update. The absolute highlight of this update is a huge content update including the complete city of Lowangen and along with it the Dungeon "Swamp of the Forgotten". This includes all the quests, dialogs, conversations, specials and other content for both locations. We are especially proud of Lowangen, the largest city in the game by far, with more than 150 buildings, three distinguishable districts and nearly 200 NPCs in the Streets. The swamp is also huge, with more than 600.000 m². Both locations have been implemented with the Version of 1994 as a template and with a myriad of improvements and corrections. And of course, there is a lot of other improvements:

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] The sleeping potion effect has been improved and extended
[*] There are now different arrow and bolt variants
[*] The slingshot can now use different ammunition types
[*] Shields have been rebalanaced
[*] Gorah's Robe (from Blade of Destiny HD) now has special properties
[*] Traumatic fever and blue wheeze are now curable by heroes
[*] New sickness: swamp fever
[*] Several uncritical errors causing log entries have been fixed
[*] Skills received values for their "effective encumberance" by equipped armor
[*] Encumberance of shields fixed
[*] Removed limit to actions when camping
[*] Fire amuletts now protect of fire damage again
[*] The remastered music track for hostels was reworked and improved
[*] The following tracks have been remastered:[list]
[*] Travel map
[*] Battle
[*] Camp
[*] Character creation / Levelup
[*] Townmusic Finsterkoppen
[*] Townmusic Tiefhusen
[*] Townmusic Lowangen
[*] Finsterkoppenbinge
[*] Swamp of the Forgotten
[/list][/list]

[h1]Dungeons and Towns[/h1]
[list]
[*] The display bug of elves in Kvirasim has been fixed
[*] The level of detail (texture resolution) of town npcs has been improved
[*] A long lasting bug with the display of scene characters has been fixed
[*] The socket puzzle in the cellar vault has been improved
[*] Market stands in Gashok now have sales personnel
[*] Market stands in Kvirasim now have sales personnel
[*] The tavern scene has been reworked
[*] Tiefhusen received more ork presence
[*] Room rental has been reduced to next day 5 o'clock (instead of 11)
[*] A problem saving doorstates in dungeons has been fixed
[*] An unintentional "fall" inside the Finsterkoppenbinge was fixed
[*] After conversations NPCs only require until midnight to reset their "mood" instead of 48 hours
[*] Citizens inside houses have been adapated depending on current location
[*] The tavern in Kvirasim isn't blocked by NPCs any more
[*] Another cellar vault puzzle has been improved
[*] Character size of scene characters was adapted to their surroundings
[/list]

[h1]Travel[/h1]
[list]
[*] A typo on the map with "Salamandersteine" was fixed
[*] The travel event "Otter" can now be solved with "heal animals"
[*] The travel map now also works in UHD-resolutions correctly
[/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to choose how many levelups shall be done at once
[*] Weapon icons have been unified in style
[*] Poison and Potion icons have been unified in style
[*] A bug when reading numbers from the user has been fixed
[*] The text on the startrail intro video has been slowed down
[*] Displaybug on item transfer in keyword dialogs has been fixed
[*] Automatic levelups have been vastly improved in quality
[/list]
[h1]Battle[/h1]
[list]
[*] Swamp rantzies can infext with swamp fever
[*] Dead enemies can no longer be killed again
[*] Pathfinding for escaping enemies has been vastly improved
[*] Conjured characters now correctly disappear again
[*] Poison effects were checked and reworked
[/list]
[h1]Modding[/h1]
[list]
[*] Leave behind and readd characters
[*] Images can now be displayed as part of a dialog
[/list]

We will update the release schedule next week, Early Access will definitely not end in February as previously announced.

notes.title: Version 0.74
notes.content:
Version 0.74 of Startrail HD is mainly a "maintenance" release, improving a myriad of small bugs and little features that were just piling up and needed to get done. Most notably, the battle speed settings were repaired, so battle should run even more smoothly now. We also completely redesigned the tavern screen, but see the complete list for yourself!

[b]Features[/b]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Encumbrance of helmets adapated
[*] Normal skills can now be influenced by current encumbrance
[*] Levelup points for all classes have been increased
[*] Salamanderstones are now labeled on the travel map
[*] The basilisk travel event has been completely redone
[/list]
[h1]Battles[/h1]
[list]
[*] Turning speed of battle avatars was increased significantly
[*] Starting size of NPC starts can now be adapted for random arenas, making these also viable for really big monsters
[*] Inserted an explanation text on the gameover screen when trying to flee from important battles
[/list]
[h1]User Interface[/h1]

[*] Character perspective in the characterscreen was adapted
[*] "New game" can now be canceled
[*] Cost for simplified levelup is displayed
[*] The school category of the magician is now displayed in green (spell increases are cheaper or have more tries for the school of the magician)
[*] Current time is displayed on camp actions like "sleep"
[*] "Change name" in the character screen received a tooltip
[*] Arenaeditor UI was adapated
[*] Arenaeditor now displays an arrow pointing north
[*] F7 copies the current coordinates to the clipboard (e.g. for bugreports)
[*] The levelup-+ is now hidden in simplified levelups whenever there aren't enough levelups left
[*] Tooltips added for all battle interface buttons
[*] "Destroy illusions" renamed to "End illusions"
[*] Number of remaining uses (e.g. for poisoned weapons, weapon kits and the like) is now displayed in the top left corner of the item icon
[*] Base setting for party movement left/right is now "rotate camera". Can be switched anytime to strafe and back with F8
[*] Effective encumbrance and the chance respecting current encumbrance is now displayed in skill tooltips
[*] Hunger bar in character screen is better readable
[*] Dialogs to "choose a character" can now have tooltips helping to decide which character to choose
[*] Characters in character screen can now be rotated (drag mouse) and are better lit
[*] Choose spell is now alphabetically sorted
[*] The radial menu is automatically closed now when opening a window
[*] Ingame help was adapted to new rules
[*] Godgrace changes at the temple are now displayed in the console (F9)
[*] Button captions for several confirmation windows adapted
[/list]

[*] NPC movement through towns improved
[*] Keyword dialog at the herbalist improved
[*] Gashok now triggers more town events
[*] Use skill "acrobatics" at the tavern now has proper tooltips
[*] Tavernscene recreated
[*] Christmas trees are gone from all towns
[*] Water of Tiefhusen and Gashok improved
[*] Schedules for Town NPCs improved

[*] Ammunition can now modify damage correclty

[*] Some overlap errors of windows fixed

notes.title: Version 0.73, Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays dear Friends! On time for this great time of the year and a little late due to a Steam downtime we are proud to present Version 0.73! Big Highlight of this Version is the completely reworked and enhanced battles, from damage types to maneuvers and actions a lot was changed, extended, improved and fixed. Moreover, we included a little christmas tree search for you, we would be happy to see some screenshots from those you found!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[b]Battle[/b][list]
[*] The battle system has been changed to "Actions", at the moment everything costs 1 Action, but therefore allows for double the movement distance
[*] All weapons now have a specific damage type (cut, thrust, blunt)
[*] Some monsters no have resistance (half damage), immunity (no damage) or vulnerability (double damage) on specific damage types
[*] Monsters can also cause specific damage types
[*] Implemented the melee maneuver "relentless attack"
[*] Implemented the ranged maneuver "targeted shot"
[*] Melee and ranged attacks now display a chance of success as a tooltip
[*] Added some buttons to make control of the battles easier
[*] Improved lighting in some battle arenas
[*] Added new simple weapons: club and wooden spear
[*] The battle arena camera can now be tilted in a wider range and can also be tilted now via right mouse button dragging
[*] Saving and loading is now also possible while in battle
[*] Items can now modify the damage caused by weapons (e.g. fine arrows or magic items)
[*] The battle order display (top left corner) was improved and also allows highlighting the next characters when hovering over the respective portrait
[*] Weapon wear and tear has been reactivated
[*] Ranged weapons are also subject to wear and tear
[*] Encumbrance is now also correctly used in ranged battle
[*] Ranged weapons are now twohanded because of the new bolt and arrow slots
[*] We can now set specific starting positions for heroes and monsters, e.g. to create battles in narrow passageways[/list][b]General[/b][list]
[*] The witch can now enchant her witch kettle, similar to druids and magicians
[*] there is an introductory text when entering the starting temple on game start
[*] Help has been extended for current topics on battle actions, maneuvers and the like
[*] The initial values for spells are more in line with the pen and paper rules
[*] The avatar in the character screen is not cut off on top any more, should it be too big
[*] The gameover text has been adapted
[*] UI scaling can now be modified with the console (F9) command "uibasescane 100" (where 100 is the percentage of the base scaling). Moving this to the settings is on our todo
[*] "Take all items" now uses the currently selected hero instead of the party leader as "first to try"
[*] The spell categories have been reorganized and extended
[*] All 8 possible companions have a unique avatar now
[*] Some scripting commands have been added or extended

notes.content:
Updatetime! After initial release last week we are already full speed ahead into the first Updates! Current plan is to have at least biweekly updates, with changes that are worth it getting their own update in between the regular schedule. Biggest changes in this update are the character generator and levelups, both are fully operational again and were extended with a "simplified" mode. In Detail:

[h1]New Features[/h1][list]
[*] The character generator is now available. As an intermediate step you can "roll" the looks of your characters from a given set specific per class until the actual character designer is implemented
[*] A simplified system for character creation has been introduced. You can switch between simplified and classic at any time in the settings
[*] Levelups are now operational
[*] A simplified system for levelups has been introduced. You can switch between simplified and classic at any time in the settings
[*] There are a lot more different camp fights now, and they are better applied according to the current location
[*] Part of the startrail quest was buggy, it can now be played from beginning to end
[*] 6 new battle arenas in night lighting have been added
[*] The fog of war on maps is now a lot more detailed. Disclaimer: This change breaks your already explored parts on the maps of dungeons and towns, you need to reexplore
[*] Tiefhusen has received citizens
[*] Opacity of windows has been increased for readability
[*] wells in towns can now be used to refill your water supplies
[*] Tiefhusen: An animation for traveling with Hensger has been introduced
[*] Binge: The lore ride received a simple animation
[*] Small hints added to the phex temple
[*] Made some balancing adjustments for journeys
[*] Set default framelimit to 60. Can be deactivated by mod or in schweif_data/_data/globalsettings.xml
[*] Stores in towns now are open from 6 am to 8 pm
[*] The fishing-hook received a (described) snell
[*] Random battles on journeys have received better balancing capabilities
[*] Help has been improved and exteded with new information. Still accessible with F1 or Questbook -> Help
[*] Tooltips for the two icon buttons in the item window[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes and improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Several battle avatars which got stuck repeatedly have been fixed
[*] The developer contact form has been fixed and now automatically attaches the output_log.txt and consolelog.txt files of your current session to better find the problem you have
[*] A spoiler in the loading screen has been removed
[*] There were some memory leaks on the travel map which have been removed
[*] Some dialogue errors have been fixed
[*] Some texting errors have been fixed
[*] There are "town limits" now that prevent the party from leaving accessible areas
[*] Some container dialogs received a suitable image
[*] All 4 market booths in Kvirasim are now working correctly
[*] The bridge in Gashok has been made safer
[*] A wrong reference to Blade of Destiny has been removed
[*] Items don't get stuck on the hero portraits any more
[*] Effect icons now correctly appear on top of the Portraits
[*] The radial menu now correctly appears after battles
[*] Binge: several smaller bugs fixed
[*] The strange bar above the minimap is gone
[*] Kvirasim: several smaller bugs fixed
[*] Binge: even equipped items now get removed correctly (e.g. the torch at efferds sponge)
[*] Tooltips and the radial menu always remain completely on screen now
[*] A memory leak on saving the fog of war has been fixed[/list]
[h1]Coming up next[/h1]
along with the usual bugfixes are the following
[list][*]Improvements in battles
[*]UI implementations for questbook, diary, recipes, help and so on[/list]

Enjoy!
